sections.Overview: Release Notes NEW MODE – Midnight Madness! Play through midnight for a 45 second hand shooting challenge. Launch balls at the moving hand, earn GROOVY flips with each hit, and complete GROOVY to light a 4x Super Hand award. Automatic midnight activation is disabled in Tournament Mode. FEATURE – Expanded speaker and topper lighting throughout movie modes, multiballs, wizard modes, attract mode, and end of ball bonus. FEATURE – Added a saved Fastest Ready Aim Fire high score for Boomstick Multiball. FEATURE – Added timed trigger bonuses during the Kandarian Demon opening and Henrietta Multiball’s “Swallow This” sequence. FEATURE – Added a last chance to finish qualifying Boomstick Multiball on the lower playfield after the final upper playfield ball drains. FEATURE – Reworked Undying Love’s grave digging animation and lighting. FEATURE – Cabin Multiball now requires two jackpot shots to light the super when adaptive assist is active. FEATURE – In Free Play, the cabinet Back button now adds one Spooky Token when tokens are enabled. MENU – Added Midnight Madness to Spooky Token play. Its default cost is 4 tokens, adjustable using TOKENS MIDNIGHT MADNESS in the Pricing/Replay menu. BUG FIX – Fixed a held ball sometimes failing to eject from the Book VUK. BUG FIX – Improved ball release during Cabin Multiball and after collecting its super jackpot. BUG FIX – Improved Hail to the King finale ball handling after a phase two timeout or drain, including balls locked before the mode began. BUG FIX – Fixed Undying Love returning to the grave prompt after completing the final scoop. BUG FIX – Improved lighting and music handling when multiballs stack with another mode. BUG FIX – Fixed attract mode topper scare audio playing when attract sounds are disabled. Release Notes MENU – Added support for Deadrings in the Mech Settings menu. Set DEADRINGS INSTALLED to 1 or 2 before installing this mod. MENU – The Shotgun Shooter Handle can now spawn jackpots during Boomstick Multiball. SHOOTER HANDLE INSTALLED must be turned ON in the Mech Settings menu. FEATURE – Increased the time available for the Super Skill Shot. FEATURE – Running timers now remain paused longer during Cabin Multiball startup. FEATURE – Spooky Tokens can now be used in Free Play. BUG FIX – Fixed an issue where Delta 88 could improperly stack with other modes. BUG FIX – Fixed an issue where the Hail to the King timer was not starting properly. BUG FIX – Fixed an issue where Cheryl Multiball could eject the ball too early. BUG FIX – Fixed an issue where Necklace inserts remained off until the Skill Shot concluded. BUG FIX – Fixed an issue where mode progress indicators did not remain lit on movie stacks until both stacks were complete. BUG FIX – Fixed an issue where VUK switches could interfere with ball searches. Various bug fixes and enhancements throughout the game. Release Notes FEATURE – New Wizard Mode: Hail to the King (25 Deadite hits). Completing the mode adds a global scoring multiplier. Disabled by default in Tournament Mode. FEATURE – New Mode: Delta 88 (88 left ramp shots to qualify). FEATURE – Added new sound effects for Deadites. FEATURE – Added brief invincibility after respawning in Video Mode. FEATURE – Adjusted Video Mode scoring. FEATURE – Added shots to spot spins and adjusted timer during Hello Lover. FEATURE – Sped up end of ball animations. FEATURE – During single ball play, a quick tap of the action button will lower the trap door. MENU – Added a setting for maximum extra balls per player. MENU – Shaker motor default set to Medium. BUG FIX – Fixed an issue in Chased By Evil that could cause a black error screen. BUG FIX – Improved reliability when clearing button lights after entering the menu from gameplay. BUG FIX – Added safeguards for invalid topper switch behavior. BUG FIX – Fixed an issue where ball save timers could fail to clear. BUG FIX – Improved cabinet switch detection. BUG FIX – Fixed an issue where Book Hold timeout could repeatedly fire the middle VUK. Release Notes FEATURE – Added a tape rewind option to Mech Settings. FEATURE – Mystery Award difficulty now increases with each subsequent attempt during the same game. FEATURE – Dead Bar functionality is now added automatically. BUG FIX – Cheryl Topper settings were not functioning correctly in the previous update. BUG FIX – Cabin Multiball audio is now assigned to a dedicated channel to prevent overwrites that could mute the mode. BUG FIX – Added protections to prevent other screens from interrupting Video Mode. BUG FIX – Added safeguards to automatically complete the launch sequence and activate the playfield when needed. BUG FIX – Increased tilt setup time to reduce the likelihood of false tilt reports. BUG FIX – Fixed an issue where the dagger mux was not clearing properly between games. Release Notes FEATURE – Earn “Spooky Tokens” during gameplay. Hold the action button while pressing Start to use tokens to play sub-wizard and wizard modes. On location, token play will still require a normal credit. Menu options allow enabling or disabling this feature and setting the number of tokens required per mode. The game awards 5 tokens immediately after updating. FEATURE – Pop bumpers now give Positive or Negative awards depending on which direction the Linda Vice is facing. Positive awards are given in a specific order. FEATURE – Super Pops now alternate as the first award from the Evil Hand. FEATURE – Inlanes now light the opposite Orbit to boost the Dagger multiplier. Use the Launch Button to activate the build-up multiplier for 10 seconds. FEATURE – Inlane completions now award extra points. Fill inlanes with all the same color for x2 extra points. FEATURE – Reworked the Evil Ash mode, including adding a Phase 2. FEATURE – Backboard eye inserts added to more modes. FEATURE – Added a roaming shot to add time during Phase 3 of Hello Lover. FEATURE – Minor improvements to It Won’t Let Us Leave. The trap door can be closed with a quick press of the action button. Additional Gameplay Settings were added for this mode. FEATURE – Minor improvements to Evil Awakens. FEATURE – Minor improvements to Hacked to Bits. FEATURE – Added a Risky Ball Save for the Auto Launch. FEATURE – Added an action button quick eject of the Middle VUK during the Book Hold. FEATURE – Added a combo sequence using the Necklace Targets in all modes that do not use the Necklace Targets in another way. FEATURE – Improved the graphics for the Mystery Award. FEATURE – Added more Book Holds during Multiballs. FEATURE – Added a hold Start to return to Ball 1. This is in addition to holding Left Flipper and Start to return to Attract Mode. FEATURE – Collect the GROOVY Targets in order to earn a 20% scoring boost for the remainder of the ball. FEATURE – Increased mode timer pause on Ball Search and Ball Locks. FEATURE – New on-screen graphics added for Action Button events. FEATURE – Added more dust to the End of Ball. MENU – New audio and visual setting to change on-screen graphics if the Spooky Shotgun Shooter Handle is installed. MENU – Added a gameplay setting to set the number of hits needed for Give Me Back My Hand. MENU – Added a mech setting for ramp position during mode starts. MENU – Added a burn-in test for the hand. MENU – Default Tilt Cooldown changed from 2s to 1s. BUG FIX – Corrected some timing issues with the Video Mode graphics. BUG FIX – Added code to prevent the topper from becoming stuck running during Attract Mode. BUG FIX – Changed the boot-up sequence if the trap door is open when the game is turned off. BUG FIX – Fixed a bug where some modes were not displaying the previous high score cards correctly. BUG FIX – Fixed a bug caused by a quick restart during High Score Entry. BUG FIX – Fixed a bug where some Topper Settings were not saving correctly. Release Notes FEATURE – New Wizard Mode: Kandarian Demon. Progress through multiple phases to defeat the demon, culminating in a final super jackpot shot. FEATURE – New Video Mode: A 70s-style action game accessed by finding hidden “lost tapes” during modes. FEATURE – Unlimited ball save added to Phase 2 of Cheryl Multiball. FEATURE – Launch button now works for Mystery Award and High Score Entry. FEATURE – Right ramp unlights during Undying Love to prevent an exploit. FEATURE – New hand-hit lightshows added. FEATURE – Extra ball settings added to the Price/Replay menu. FEATURE – Extra ball moved to the second hand award. BUG FIX – Corrected tilt bugs in One Handed Kitchen Fight and Mirror, Mirror. BUG FIX – Hacked to Bits scoring increased. Release Notes FEATURE – Destroy the Book wizard mode added, unlocked after completing all four modes from Evil Dead. FEATURE – Kitchen Fight mode added as the second reward for hand hits during base gameplay. FEATURE – 32 new videos added for mode qualification progression. FEATURE – Ball save timers extended for Cheryl Multiball and Henrietta Multiball. FEATURE – Sound added to Super Spinner introduction video. FEATURE – Hand reward logic improved and better feedback for progression. FEATURE – Sub-wizard modes can no longer be restarted. BUG FIX – Flipper settings now correctly apply through the coil settings menu. BUG FIX – Hand position testing improved for better accuracy. BUG FIX – Fixed a graphic issue where scores could temporarily disappear. BUG FIX – Lighting glitch resolved on the 1, 2, 3 inserts used for Blood Flood Multiplier. BUG FIX – Right orbit shots no longer register with the return of center spinner. BUG FIX – Fixed an issue in Cheryl Multiball Phase 2 where both fail and success states could trigger simultaneously. Release Notes FEATURE – Hero From The Sky wizard mode added to the game. FEATURE – Mirror, Mirror sanity mode added to the game. BUG FIX – Time settings in the menu have been fixed. BUG FIX – If the final shot in Laughing was to the scoop under the right ramp, the ball was not ejecting correctly. SINCE BETA – Extended ball save timer for Mirror Mirror. SINCE BETA – Fixed a bug where Evil Ash stacked with multiballs could cause a crash. SINCE BETA – Fixed a bug where outlane saves were not working in multiballs. Release Notes FEATURE – Cheryl Multiball has been added, qualified by completing two modes from the first film; performance in Phase 2 determines one of two unique multiball variants. FEATURE – New Linda Trick added – Reverse Flippers; menu options now allow players to disable individual tricks or prevent flipper reversal entirely. FEATURE – Cabin drop targets now retain their state between most modes, balls, and players, making Cabin Multiball easier to qualify. FEATURE – Cheryl and Henrietta Multiballs can now be restarted if missed. FEATURE – Henrietta Multiball scoring has been rebalanced for improved pacing and reward. FEATURE – Ball save time during Henrietta Multiball has been increased. FEATURE – Groovy flipper inserts now light less frequently to improve their visual impact. FEATURE – Playfield activation now occurs more quickly following a skillshot attempt. BUG FIX – Fixed an issue where ball search could generate error logs. BUG FIX – Fixed a bug preventing the Right VUK from ejecting the ball. BUG FIX – Fixed Henrietta’s “neck stretch” video from being cut off by drop target animations. BUG FIX – Fixed a tilt-related bug involving a ball in play on the lower playfield. MENU – Added new warnings to the factory reset screens to help prevent accidental data loss. POST BETA – Improved handling of critical error messages. POST BETA – Decreased the delay of reverse flipper warning callouts. POST BETA – Improved handling of end of ball callouts.
